scripts.compact: node ../../../../tooling/scripts/ensure-compact-artifacts.mjs --manifest src/managed/.compact-artifact.json --source-root src --output src/managed/iso-registry --recipe-input scripts/strip-managed-sourcemaps.mjs -- sh -c "compact compile src/iso-registry.compact src/managed/iso-registry && node ./scripts/strip-managed-sourcemaps.mjs"
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist && rm -rf coverage && rm -rf reports && rm -rf src/managed

scripts.all: pnpm run compact && pnpm run build && pnpm run test:ci
